title: Vapouriz Premium Menthol Special Blend E-Liquid 10ml
description: Crisp, clean and offering a delicious balance of sweet, delicate spearmint, punchy peppermint and bracing menthol, Menthol Special Blend is a superbly crafted menthol e-liquid that has become a favourite among countless menthol fans. Super-refreshing, the rush of cool menthol is mellowed with the freshness of mint to sublime effect. Vapouriz E-Liquids are expertly-crafted by Vapouriz Labs UK to deliver intense flavour and stunning vapour production for your e-cigarette setup. Browse the full collection of Vapouriz Premium E-Liquids and pick up the perfect pairing for any Vape Kit , Starter Vape Kits or Compact Pod Vape Kit . We’ve got a selection of formulations to suit all styles of e-cigarette devices, including High-PG blends for classic vaping as well as Vapouriz Nicotine Salts and adaptable 50:50 Vape Juice options.
